name: Shopping Mall Facial Recognition Watchlist
description: Cameras at the entrances of a fictional shopping mall identify every visitor by matching faces against a database built from photos scraped from public social-media profiles. The system tags 'VIP shoppers' for marketing and 'undesirable persons' who are automatically denied entry by the gates.
documentation:
DATA: biometric face templates of all visitors, including children; scraped social-media photos and names.
CONSENT AND NOTICE: no signage and no consent; visitors are unaware.
DECISION: 'undesirable' list is compiled by security staff without criteria; gates deny entry automatically.
VENDOR: facial-recognition vendor abroad; biometric data transferred without assessment or DPA.
ACCURACY: no testing on the local population; no false-match rate measured.
RETENTION: templates kept indefinitely; shared with tenant stores for marketing.
